sourceLicense.notice: Static predicate/mechanics facts from fixed AGPL-marked source. No independent permissive license or Pokémon asset rights asserted.

metadata.method: Independent TypeScript AST syntax reader and constant binding of our normalized IR. Upstream callbacks, methods, imports, constructors, Phaser and eval are never executed.

excluded: custom TrainerConfig clones and mystery encounter overrides

metadata.enumProvenance: Enum values use same-commit AST-extracted rogue-world-reference.json, plus Region parsed directly from pokemon-species.ts.

operatorSchema.flag: field; omitted species boolean fields default false
operatorSchema.hasLevelMove: moveId; all levels from base+base-form level moves, no prevo inheritance
operatorSchema.hasTm: moveId; base+base-form TMs plus recursive base prevo TMs
operatorSchema.unknown: omissionIndex; must block/mark generation unavailable, never become true

samplingSemantics.globalGeneric: First isCatchable AND effective predicate on every species. Then map each accepted species to its oldest prevo and deduplicate roots unless filterAllEvolutions=true. Sample roots uniformly. Do not re-filter the mapped root by specialty type.
samplingSemantics.explicitSpeciesPools: Trainer.genNewPartyMemberSpecies uses config.speciesPools directly and bypasses this generic predicate.
samplingSemantics.partyMemberCallbacks: Explicit positive/negative slot callbacks bypass generic filtering. Their own factory/filter semantics are separate.
samplingSemantics.replacement: setSpeciesFilter(predicate,true) replaces the entire prior filter, including legendary AND trainer-forbidden guards. An omitted/false second argument ANDs new predicate first, prior filter second.
samplingSemantics.champion: initForChampion does not change speciesFilter; explicit roster callbacks may still use legendary species.
samplingSemantics.catchableName: isCatchable here is the source global NPC-random candidate gate, not permission to throw a ball at every wild encounter.

notes: getTms recursively inherits prevo TMs; getLevelMoves does not inherit prevo level moves.
Unspecified form resolves to forms[0].formKey, or empty string if no forms.
Level move find predicates test move ID at any declared level, including level0/-1, without comparing NPC current level.

dataGaps.impact: hasTm/hasLevelMove predicates depend on this data; unknown data must remain unknown, never widen to all species.
